plugins.name: exposure-audit
plugins.description: A Claude skill that audits your own setup and tells you which API keys you have left lying around. Scopes your surface first, then runs the twenty classic vibe-coding vulnerability checks against it. Catches the three things published lists miss: live keys inside cloud-synced folders, unrevoked keys from products you shut down, and abandoned deployments still holding environment variables. Never prints a secret value, never fixes anything, and reports NOT RUN instead of guessing.
